dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: What a wondrous room. It's like we've entered into a dream...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: This seems like the perfect place to let go of reality, and immerse oneself in flights of fantasy.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: I believe this can be a form of spiritual nourishment.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Allow me to offer my blessings to the brave warriors who have entered the Domain.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Wounds are not an apt reward for such tribulation... May their pain be soothed by the moonlight.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: And may the blessings of the Frostmoon be true to you.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: I asked Wolfy some questions about this place. He seemed very happy to answer them.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Hehe... It's a little embarrassing to say, but I thought I could only talk to him because of my ability to communicate with animals.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: It seems that there are still many things I need to learn about in this world.
